english.title: Fail to comply with police direction to leave vicinity,

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Serious Organised Crime and Police Act 2005

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been given a direction by a constable on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE..) to

(A)_[leave the vicinity of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..),]_
(B)_[leave the vicinity of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), and not return to it within **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD..),]_

failed to comply with that direction by returning to the vicinity of the premises in question on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE OF RETURN..), this date being within the period specified in the direction and you did so for the purpose of representing to or persuading

(C)_[the resident]_
(D)_[an individual]_

(E)_[that he should not do something that he is entitled or required to do, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT ENTITLED TO DO..)]_
(F)_[that he should do something that he is not under any obligation to do, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT NOT OBLIGED TO DO..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 42(7A) and (7B) of the Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
having been given a direction by a constable
to leave the vicinity of premises OR
leave the vicinity of premises and not return to it
within such period as the constable may specify
you failed to comply with that direction
by returning to the vicinity of the premises in question on a date
this date being within the period specified in the direction
you did so for the purposes of representing to/persuading the resident/an individual
that he should not do something that he is entitled/required to do OR
that he should do something that he is not under any obligation to do

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence was inserted by section 127 of the Serious Organised Crime and Police Act 2005.
(ii) The period specified by a constable in option B above may not be longer than 3 months and the date from which the period is calculated begins with the date on which the direction was given.
(iii) A dwelling has the same meaning as in Part 1 of the Public Order Act 1986.

other.penalty:
Fifty one weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Until the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the penalty will be - Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
